name: AI Security & Governance

exam.format: Free on-demand course certificate: 8 modules with 8 quizzes and a final certification exam, all online, with no prerequisites. Securiti estimates 2–2.5 hours for the course; that is not a personal exam-preparation estimate. A badge for each module and a certificate on completion, which qualifies for 1.5 IAPP CPE credits.

free_routes.text: The course, quizzes, final exam and certificate are free; registering saves progress and earns the badges.

scope: AI discovery, risk assessment, data relationships, input/output controls and governance.
ai_policy: Review the course's assessment instructions; completion time does not imply unaided applied mastery.
caveats: The course page does not state the number of final-exam questions, the passing score or whether the certificate expires.
